preconditions.description: Attacker must be authorized (owner or authorized wallet) to call setFees_base1000 function
Contract must have tradingOpen = true (trading enabled)

exploit_hint: As an authorized user, call setFees_base1000 with all fee parameters set to zero (liquidityFee=0, marketingFee=0, teamFee=0, developmentFee=0, burnFee=0, buybackFee=0). This will set totalFee = 0, causing division by zero in takeFee function when totalFee is used as denominator for burnTokens calculation (feeAmount.mul(burnFee).div(totalFee)). This will revert transactions and potentially freeze the contract's fee mechanism.
